newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS START TRAINING FOR LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS START TRAINING FOR LIONS.

text.p: Springbok manager Andre Markgraaff has invited a squad of 27 players to attend the Sports Science Institute in Cape Town in preparation for a busy year for the world champions.

The four-day programme will make use of advanced sports science equipment available at the Institute and test all areas of the player's physiological fitness levels. Explaining the decision, Markgraaff said in a statement:
"Due to certain circumstances we were not as well prepared as we could have been last year for the All Blacks tour and I feel this may have contributed to our results.

"This year we will be better prepared and we will be ready when the Lions arrive and for the Tri-Nations series. This testing programme is the first step in what we hope will be a highly successful season."
South Africa lost four out of five tests against New Zealand in 1996 but were unbeaten on the close season tour to Argentina, France and Wales.

Markgraaf said the 27 names should not be regarded as a guide to the composition of the Springboks. "There were at least another 13 or 14 that I wanted to include, but 27 was the maximum number who could be accommodated on the programme."
The 27 players consist of the 21 who formed the team and bench against Wales last month together with two other members of the touring squad.

Four players who did not tour due to injury are also named. They are Free State prop Os du Randt, Transvaal scrumhalf Johan Roux, Northern Transvaal lock Johan Ackermann and Western Province wing Chester Williams.
For Williams it is a return to the big time. The left wing who played in the World Cup final missed the whole 1996 season after undergoing knee surgery.

Squad: Andre Joubert, Jacques Olivier, James Small, Chester Williams, Andre Snyman, Hennie le Roux, Japie Mulder, Henry Honiball, Joost van der Westhuizen, Johan Roux, Kevin Putt, Gary Teichmann, Ruben Kruger, Wayne Fyvie, Fritz van Heerden, Andre Venter, Hannes Strydom, Kobus Wiese, Mark Andrews, Johan Ackermann, Marius Hurter, Os du Randt, Dawie Theron, Toks van der Linde, Adrian Garvey, James Dalton, Henry Tromp.
